entries.71d1f13f7aad68f3: Its corporate philosophy is 'We aim to be Japan's highest-quality supermarket,' and its commitments are 'Richer and tastier' and 'Health and peace of mind.' To differentiate itself, it will deepen its 6MD product policy and focus on detailed product assortment, proposal-based product development and developing new procurement routes. For new store openings, its main format combines fresh food with clothing, with priority given to Sapporo and its surrounding area, central and eastern Hokkaido, and it also plans to roll out small-catchment food stores for smaller towns and villages. From the 57th fiscal year, it will begin its next medium-term management plan, which advances structural reform and growth strategies.
entries.9de3ea30920a1e9f: A single-segment supermarket business operating stores in Hokkaido. As of February 28, 2026, it operated 33 stores: 21 in Sapporo and surrounding areas, 7 in the Dōtō area, 1 in the Dōhoku area, 2 in the Dōnan area, and 2 in the Shiribeshi area. It has no consolidated subsidiaries and conducts business through the filing company alone, with 383 employees. The Lucky Fresh and Deli Center, which processes and supplies meat, fresh fish and prepared foods, and the cold storage center, which delivers fruit, vegetables and marine products, support the stores.
entries.a274a19e38995c9c: Products related to the home. In sales by product for the fiscal year ended February 2026, household goods were 99.3% of the prior year.

entries.beb9ef4844152ebb: At 33 stores in Hokkaido, it sells mainly fresh food along with general groceries and family clothing, among others. It is deepening its 6MD, the pillar of its product policy, with the Lucky Fresh Food and Deli Center responsible for processing and supplying meat, fresh fish and prepared foods.
entries.d2e93246cf40639a: Food products, mainly fresh food products. It handles fresh food products such as vegetables, fruit, fresh fish and meat, and general food products such as processed foods. In sales by product for the fiscal year ended February 2026, food products were 101.1% of the prior year.
entries.d887ca936254ef1e: A supermarket operator headquartered in Teine Ward, Sapporo City. It operates on a standalone basis with no consolidated subsidiaries, and has 383 employees (as of February 28, 2026).
entries.def09c6524fd4926: Local customers who use the stores
entries.e97ef8e67a46f50c: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥37,199 million, 100.8% of the previous year, with the reasons cited being the inclusion from the start of the period of revenue from the Lucky Mart Shiraoi and Lucky Mart Nanporo stores, which opened partway through the previous fiscal year, and an increase in average spend per customer accompanying rising prices. In September 2025, it carried out store renovation at Lucky Chitose Nishikicho store and seismic retrofitting work at the Lucky Low-Temperature Center.
entries.ebb94cfcc783a4e6: It operates supermarkets in Hokkaido, selling mainly fresh food, along with general groceries and family clothing at its stores.
entries.ec3663805169a736: Overview of operating results in MD&A, management policy, business environment and issues to be addressed, etc.
entries.f781f680e79e633e: Among the 6MD product policy, the pursuit of taste and the pursuit of health and peace of mind are the company's core principles, and it presents seasonal and local-flavor products on the sales floor. Cooking and processing previously done at each store have been consolidated at the Lucky Fresh Food and Deli Center, and it has set up a Food Safety and Hygiene Office that conducts its own product inspections, supporting stores in both the products themselves and the supply system.
entries.f973e4057af4962f: It operates a single segment, the supermarket business, with 33 stores across Hokkaido. Hokkaido has continued to have a large number of supermarket stores, and it also competes with convenience stores, drugstores that handle food full-scale, online supermarkets and others. No single external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue from external customers.
